Perustettava dynaaminen hankintajärjestelmä jakautuu seuraaviin osa-alueisiin joiden sisällä suoritetaan osa-aluekohtaiset kilpailutukset dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän voimassaolon aikana: • Osa-alue 1: Perusterveydenhuollon laitteet • Osa-alue 2: Erikoissairaanhoidon laitteet • Osa-alue 3: Välinehuollon laitteet • Osa-alue 4: Laboratoriolaitteet • Osa-alue 5: Hyvinvointialueiden toimipisteiden käytössä olevat apuvälineet • Osa-alue 6: Kuvantamislaitteet • Osa-alue 7: Huollon mittalaitteet Dynaamiseen hankintajärjestelmään voivat hakea Tarjoajaksi kaikki sellaiset ehdokkaat, jotka täyttävät ESPD-lomakkeella ilmoitetut soveltuvuusvaatimukset. Dynaamiseen hankintajärjestelmään hyväksytään kaikki Tarjoajat, jotka täyttävät asetetut soveltuvuusvaatimukset. Kaikki kiinnostuneet tarjoajat voivat koko dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän keston ajan pyytää oikeutta osallistua dynaamiseen hankintajärjestelmään. Dynaamiseen hankintajärjestelmään hyväksyttävien ehdokkaiden määrää ei ole rajoitettu. Tarjoaja hakeutuu dynaamiseen hankintajärjestelmään jättämällä osallistumishakemuksen. Dynaaminen hankintajärjestelmä on kuvattu tarkemmin osallistumispyynnössä ja sen liitteissä.

buyer: УНИВЕРСИТЕТСКА МНОГОПРОФИЛНА БОЛНИЦА ЗА АКТИВНО ЛЕЧЕНИЕ "КАНЕВ" АД
title: Bulgaria – Pharmaceutical products – „Доставка на лекарствени продукти, които не са включени в Приложение 2 на ПЛС, за нуждите на УМБАЛ „КАНЕВ“ АД
description: ДСП се създава за периодична доставка по предварителна заявка на лекарствени продукти, които не са включени в Приложение 2 на ПЛС по чл. 262, ал. 6, т. 2 от ЗЛПХМ, необходими за изпълнение на лечебната дейност в УМБАЛ „КАНЕВ” АД. Лекарствените продукти, предмет на процедурата са представени в първоначална "Техническа спецификация“ /част от документацията за участие/, с посочени лекарствени форми, количество лекарствено вещество, единица мярка и необходимо прогнозно количество. Първоначално планиранираната "Техническа спецификация" може да бъде частично променяна в хода на провеждане на динамичната система, като се добавят нови лекарствени продукти и/или се променят количествата им. Посочените количества в приложената към настоящите указания „Техническа спецификация“ са прогнозни и не пораждат задължение за Възложителя да ги възложи в прогнозния обем. Кандидатите, включени в ДСП могат да подадат оферта за един или повече редове, както и могат да не подадат оферта. ДСП ще функционира в рамките на 36 /тридесет и шест/ месеца, като в този период Възложителят може да отправя покани до включените в ДСП кандидати за събиране на оферти за всяка конкретна поръчка за доставка на лекарствени продукти, в рамките на ДСП. Срок на договорите, сключвани въз основа на ограничените поръчки в рамките на ДСП е за период от 12 месеца. ДСП функционира на два етапа, както следва: ПЪРВИ ЕТАП НА ДИНАМИЧНАТА СИСТЕМА ЗА ПОКУПКИ – СЪБИРАНЕ НА ЗАЯВЛЕНИЯ ЗА УЧАСТИЕ: Квалифициране на доставчиците (допускане на доставчиците до системата). На този етап се събират заявления за участие в ДСП. Заявленията за участие /ЕЕДОП/ съдържат информация относно личното състояние на кандидатите и критериите за подбор, поставени от Възложителя. Краен срок за подаване на първоначални заявления - 29.07.2026 г. Разглеждането на първоначалните заявления за участие се извършва в срок до 10 /десет/ работни дни от крайният срок за подаване на първоначални заявления, след което Възложителят определя с решение за подбор с което квалифицираните доставчици се включват в ДСП. След първоначалния срок за подаване на заявления, Възложителят ще разглежда новопостъпилите заявления два пъти в месеца /всеки понеделник от първата и третата седмица на месеца/. След всяко разглеждане на заявленията, Възложителят издава решение за подбор. След влизане в сила на решението за подбор следва втори етап на процедурата. ВТОРИ ЕТАП НА ДИНАМИЧНАТА СИСТЕМА ЗА ПОКУПКИ – СЪБИРАНЕ НА ОФЕРТИ ПО КОНКРЕТНИ ПОКАНИ: След влизане в сила на първоначалното решение за включване на одобрените кандидатите в ДСП, Възложителят обявява отделни процедури в рамките на ДСП. За всяка конкретна процедура, Възложителят изпраща покана за представяне на оферти за конкретната поръчка до всички кандидати, включени в ДСП. Офертите на кандидатите съдържат техническо и ценово предложение. Офертите ще бъдат класирани от програма, която ще бъде достъпна и безплатна за участниците.

buyer: Kulttuurin ja vapaa-ajan toimiala, Helsingin kaupunki
title: EU-Dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän osallistumispyyntö: Harrastamisen Suomen malli Helsingissä 2024-2029 (DPS)
description: Helsingin kaupunki tulee kilpailuttamaan lapsille ja nuorille suunnatun harrastustoiminnan järjestämisen aikajaksolla elokuu 2025 – kesäkuu 2029 osana Harrastamisen Suomen malli Helsingissä hanketta. Tämän ajanjakson aikana julkaistaan useampia tarjouspyyntöjä. Kilpailutukset toteutetaan nyt perustettavan dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän puitteissa. Dynaaminen hankintajärjestelmä on kaksivaiheinen. Ensimmäisessä vaiheessa dynaamisessa hankintajärjestelmässä ilmoittaudutaan mukaan ko. järjestelmään ja siinä tarkistetaan ehdokkaan soveltuvuus ja toisessa vaiheessa ehdokkaat voivat antaa tarjouksia tarjouskilpailuihin, jotka järjestetään DPS järjestelmän sisällä. Kaikki kelpoisuus- ja vähimmäisvaatimukset täyttävät toimittajat valitaan mukaan DPS:ään. Harrastamisen Suomen malli Helsingissä tarjoaa lasten ja nuorten toiveisiin perustuvia maksuttomia harrastuksia koulupäivän yhteydessä. Laadukkaat ja monipuoliset harrastukset toteutetaan koulujen tiloissa ja niiden lähiympäristössä. Kannustamme seuroja, järjestöjä, yrityksiä ja muita harrastusten tuottajia ilmoittautumaan mukaan harrastusten järjestäjiksi Helsingissä. Helsingissä tarjoamme maksuttomia harrastuksia koulujen 3.–9. luokkien oppilaille suomen, ruotsin ja englannin kielillä. Harrastusryhmät kokoontuvat koulujen tiloissa tai lähiympäristössä koulupäivän jälkeen, pääsääntöisesti ennen klo 17. Toteutamme Harrastamisen Suomen mallia kolmen korin periaatteella. Helsingin kouluissa on tarjolla kulttuurisia, liikunnallisia sekä digitaalisia tai muita harrastuksia. Harrastamisen Suomen malli Helsingissä harrastamisen periaatteet on kuvattu liitteessä 1 Toimintakriteerit. , Kulttuurinen harrastustoiminta Osa-alueen 1 hankintojen kohteena ovat lapsille ja nuorille suunnatut kulttuuriset harrastustoimintapalvelut. Osa-alueen harrastustoiminnan ohjauskerta voi koskea esimerkiksi seuraavia harrastuksia: kuvataide, animaatio, elokuva ja mediataide, tanssi, teatteri ja sirkus, musiikki ja muu harrastustoiminta. Hankintayksikkö voi kilpailuttaa tässä osa-alueessa myös muuta näihin verrattavissa olevia kulttuurillisia harrastustoiminnan ohjaustunteja., Liikunnallinen harrastustoiminta Osa-alueen 2 hankintojen kohteena ovat lapsille ja nuorille suunnatut liikunnalliset harrastustoimintapalvelut. Osa-alueen harrastustoiminnan ohjauskerta voi koskea esimerkiksi seuraavia harrastuksia: pallo- ja mailapelit, parkour, kamppailu- ja voimailulajit, muu laji. Hankintayksikkö voi kilpailuttaa tässä osa-alueessa myös muuta näihin verrattavissa olevan liikunnallisen harrastustoiminnan ohjaustunteja., Digitaalinen ja muu harrastustoiminta Osa-alueen 3 hankintojen kohteena ovat lapsille ja nuorille suunnatut digitaaliset ja muut harrastustoimintapalvelut. Osa-alueen harrastustoiminnan ohjauskerta voi koskea esimerkiksi seuraavia harrastuksia: digitaaliset pelit ja koodaus, ruokaharrastus, eläin- ja luontoharrastus ja muu laji. Hankintayksikkö voi kilpailuttaa tässä osa-alueessa myös muuta näihin verrattavissa olevan digitaalisen ja muun harrastustoiminnan ohjaustunteja.,

title: Germany – Pharmaceutical products – Abschluss einer nicht-exklusiven Rabattvereinbarung nach § 130a Abs. 8 SGB V zum Wirkstoff Olanzapin (ausschl. Dafo. TRS), ATC N05AH03 für die Zeit 01.09.2026 - 31.08.2028 (zzgl. V.-Option 1x12 Mon)
description: § 130a Absatz 8 SGB V ermöglicht den Krankenkassen und pharmazeutischen Unternehmen, Rahmenrabattverträge über die zu Lasten der gesetzlichen Krankenkassen abzugebenden Arzneimittel zuschließen. title: Mielenterveys- ja päihdeasumispalveluiden hankinta
description: Hankinnan kohteena on mielenterveys- ja päihdeasumispalvelut Pohjois-Pohjanmaan hyvinvointialueella. Palveluntuottajarekisterissä hankinnan kohteena ovat sosiaalihuoltolain (1301/2014) perusteella järjestettävät asumispalvelut ja asumiseen liittyvät palvelut asiakkaille, joilla on päihteiden ongelmakäytöstä tai mielenterveysongelmasta johtuva tuen tarve. Palveluntuottajarekisterin kohde ja ehdot on kuvattu tarkemmin osallistumispyynnön liitteessä Palveluntuottajarekisterin periaatteet. Hankinnan kohteena palveluntuottajarekisterissä on: LUOKKA 1 Tuettu asuminen LUOKKA 2 Yhteisöllinen asuminen LUOKKA 3 Ympärivuorokautinen palveluasuminen, LUOKKA 1 Tuettu asuminen Luokka 1 pitää sisällään tuetun asumisen palvelut, jotka on tarkoitettu henkilöille, joilla on toimintakykyä, halua ja motivaatiota kuntoutua itsenäiseen asumiseen. Palveluiden lyhyet kuvaukset löytyvät liitteestä "Palveluntuottajarekisterin periaatteet" kohdasta 2. Palveluntuottajarekisterin kohde ja rakenne. Hankinnan kohde kuvataan tarkemmin jokaisen palveluntuottajarekisterin sisäisen tarjouspyynnön liitteenä olevassa palvelukuvauksessa., LUOKKA 2 Yhteisöllinen asuminen Luokka 2 pitää sisällään yhteisöllisen asumisen palvelut, jotka on tarkoitettu asiakkaille, joiden kyky huolehtia itsestään ja muu toimintakyky ovat merkittävästi heikentyneet. title: RFSA - Provision of Hydrographic/Bathymetric production services.
description: NOTICE OF PROPOSED PROCUREMENT (NPP) This bid solicitation cancels and supersedes previous bid solicitation number 30004518 dated August 29, 2024 with a closing of October 16, 2025 at 14:00 Atlantic Time. Submissions for 30004518 will no longer be accepted. This solicitation will remain on CanadaBuys until June 30, 2029. The Canadian Hydrographic Service (CHS) of Fisheries and Oceans Canada (DFO) has a requirement to establish a number of Supply Arrangement (SA) with pre-qualified suppliers to meet the general requirements specified in each of the following service streams: a. STREAM 1: Hydrographic/Bathymetric Training Services; b. STREAM 2: Hydrographic Navigational Charting Support and Production services; c. STREAM 3: Bathymetric Data Assessment and Processing services; and d. STREAM 4: Hydrographic/Bathymetric Consulting services. These services will be required on an as required basis throughout the period(s) of the Supply Arrangement. The Canadian Hydrographic Service (CHS) is mandated to chart Canadian waters to ensure safe navigation and to protect Canadian sovereignty. In that endeavour CHS must collect hydrographic/bathymetric data in support of new digital charting products as well as maintain existing portfolios of nautical charts in a variety of formats. This must be done using current international charting standards of data collection, processing and production. The proposed period of the Supply Arrangement is five (5) years from the date of issuance to December 31, 2029. There are security requirements associated with this requirement. For additional information, consult Part 1 - General Information, and Part 6A - Supply Arrangement. For more information on personnel and organization security screening or security clauses, Suppliers should refer to the Contract Security Program of Public Works and Government Services Canada (http://www.tpsgc-pwgsc.gc.ca/esc-src/introduction-eng.html) website. The Request for Supply Arrangements (RFSA) is to establish supply arrangements for the delivery of the requirement detailed in the RFSA to the Identified Users across Canada, excluding locations within Yukon, Northwest Territories, Nunavut, Quebec, and Labrador that are subject to Comprehensive Land Claims Agreements (CLCAs). Any requirement for deliveries to locations within CLCAs areas within Yukon, Northwest Territories, Nunavut, Quebec, or Labrador will have to be treated as a separate procurement, outside of the resulting supply arrangements. To allow new suppliers to qualify, the Request for Supply Arrangement will be posted on the Government Electronic Tendering Service (GETS) up to six (6) months prior to its expiry date.

Tyynyjä käytetään korkealta pelastamisen suojaksi. Tarkemmat vaatimukset määritellään kilpailutuskohtaisesti dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän sisäisissä kilpailutuksissa., Paloletkut Paloletkuja tarvitaan eri kokoisia 1"-6" välillä. Paloletkut ovat 20 metriä pitkiä ja käytetään vedensiirtoon ja sammuttamiseen. Letkuja menee arvolta keskimäärin vuodessa seuraavasti: - 1" letkua 2-3 km vuodessa - 42mm letkua 3-4km vuodessa - 76mm letkua 2 km vuodessa. - Isompia tarpeen mukaan noin 1km vuodessa. Tarkemmat vaatimukset määritellään kilpailutuskohtaisesti dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän sisäisissä kilpailutuksissa., Putoamisvaarallisella alueella työskentelyn välineet Putoamisvaarallisella alueella työskentely on toimintaa, joka tapahtuu erilaisissa rakenteissa, nostokoreista, niiden työtasoilta käsin tai johon muutoin liittyy putoamisvaara. Siihen kuuluu muun muassa työ, jossa suoritetaan laskeutumisia köydellä, henkilön nostoja ja laskuja erikoisvarustein sekä kattotyöskentelyä tulipalo- tai muissa onnettomuustilanteissa. Tähän tarkoitukseen soveltuvia välineitä ovat mm. kokovaljaat, lantiovaljaat, köydet, nauhalenkit, sulkurenkaat, tarraimet, nosto- ja laskulaitteet., Armatuurikalusto Armatuurikalustolla tarkoitetaan erilaisia sammutustehtäviin soveltuvia suihkuputkia, jakoliittimiä, vesiseiniä yms. armatuurivälineitä. description: Динамичната система за покупки (ДСП) се създава за доставка на медицински изделия за нуждите на възложителя. title: Bulgaria – Pharmaceutical products – Динамична система за покупки с предмет: „Доставка на лекарствени продукти за нуждите на „КОЦ- В. Търново“ ЕООД
description: Срок на действие на ДСП (Етап 1): 36 (тридесет и шест) месеца, считано от датата на публикуване на обявлението в ЦАИС ЕОП. Срок на конкретните договори (Етап 2): Договорите, сключвани в изпълнение на конкретните покани (ограничени процедури) в рамките на системата, ще бъдат със срок на изпълнение 18 (осемнадесет) месеца. Прогнозната стойност на ДСП е изчислена за целия 36-месечен срок и включва предвиден финансов ресурс за обезпечаване на възникнали извънредни, специфични или нови медицински нужди на лечебното заведение. Включените в първоначалната Техническа спецификация (Приложение № 1) количества лекарствени продукти са ориентировъчни и покриват прогнозното потребление на Възложителя за първоначален период от 18 месеца. Възложителят си запазва правото при провеждането на всяка последваща конкретна поръчка (покана за оферти) на Етап 2 да променя и актуализира количествата, както и да добавя изцяло нови номенклатури (лекарствени продукти), съобразно реалните и актуални потребности на болницата, до достигане на общия финансов лимит на системата.

description: ДСП се създава за доставка на различни видове лекарствени продукти за нуждите на „МБАЛ – Д-Р АСЕН ВЕЛЕВ“ ЕООД. Посочените количества по Техническата спецификация са прогнозни и не пораждат задължения за Възложителя да ги възложи в прогнозния обем. Фактическото изпълнение на обществената поръчка ще се определи на базата на реално доставените лекарствени продукти, в рамките на финансовия ресурс. ДСП се провежда на два етапа. ПЪРВИ ЕТАП НА ДИНАМИЧНАТА СИСТЕМА ЗА ПОКУПКИ – СЪБИРАНЕ НА ЗАЯВЛЕНИЯ ЗА УЧАСТИЕ Квалифициране на доставчиците (допускане на доставчиците до системата). На този етап се събират заявления за участие. Заявленията за участие /ЕЕДОП/ съдържа/т информация относно личното състояние на кандидатите и критериите за подбор. Краен срок за подаване на първоначални заявления - 12.08.2026 г. След първоначалния срок за подаване на заявления Възложителят ще разглежда новопостъпилите заявления два пъти в месеца. След всяко разглеждане на заявленията Възложителят издава решение за подбор с което квалифицираните доставчици се присъединяват към ДСП. Разглеждането на първоначалните заявления за участие ще се извърши в срок до 10 работни дни от крайният срок за подаване на първоначални заявления, след което Възложителят определя с решение за подбор квалифицираните доставчици. След влизане в сила на решението за подбор следва втори етап на процедурата. ВТОРИ ЕТАП НА ДИНАМИЧНАТА СИСТЕМА ЗА ПОКУПКИ – СЪБИРАНЕ НА ОФЕРТИ ПО КОНКРЕТНИ ПОКАНИ След допускане до ДСП на кандидатите, подали заявление следва изпращане на покана за представяне на оферти за конкретна обществена поръчка до тези доставчици. Офертите съдържат техническо и ценово предложение. За възлагане на поръчките във втория етап Възложителят обявява отделни ограничени процедури в рамките на ДСП!

title: ADVANCED RESEARCH ANNOUNCEMENT (ARA) TITLE: ADVANCED TRACKING ARCHITECTURE USING AI (ATA-AI)
description: NAICS CODE: 541715 FEDERAL AGENCY NAME: Department of the Air Force, Air Force Materiel Command, AFRL - Rome Research Site, AFRL/Information Directorate, 26 Electronic Parkway, Rome, NY, 13441-4514 ARA ANNOUNCEMENT TYPE: Initial Announcement ADVANCED RESEARCH ANNOUNCEMENT (ARA) TITLE: ADVANCED TRACKING ARCHITECTURE USING AI (ATA-AI) BAA or ARA NUMBER: FA8750-24-S-7004 PART I � OVERVIEW INFORMATION This announcement is for an Open, 2 Step ARA which is open and effective until 12 July 2029. Only white papers will be accepted as initial submissions; formal proposals will be accepted by invitation only. While white papers will be considered if received prior to 5pm Eastern Standard Time (EST) on 12 July 2029, the following submission dates are suggested to best align with projected funding: FY25 by 30 NOV 2024 FY26 by 30 NOV 2025 FY27 by 30 NOV 2026 FY28 by 30 NOV 2027 FY29 by 30 NOV 2028 Offerors should monitor the Contract Opportunities on the SAM website at https://SAM.gov in the event this announcement is amended. CONCISE SUMMARY OF TECHNOLOGY REQUIREMENT: Seeking research to design, develop, test, evaluate, and deliver innovative technologies and techniques for Next Generation Target Tracking architectures, which exploit a wide array of data sources and leverage the power of Artificial Intelligence (AI), Machine Learning (ML), and Machine Inferencing (MI) algorithms in a High Performance Computing (HPC) enabled framework. ARA ESTIMATED FUNDING: Total funding for this ARA is approximately $99M. Individual awards will not normally exceed 48 months with dollar amounts normally ranging from $1M to $10M. There is also the potential to make awards up to any dollar value as long as the value does not exceed the available ARA ceiling amount. ANTICIPATED INDIVIDUAL AWARDS: Multiple Awards are anticipated. However, the Air Force reserves the right to award zero, one, or more Procurement Contracts or Other Transactions, for all, some, or none of the solicited effort based on the offeror�s ability to perform desired work and funding fluctuations. There is no limit on the number of OTs that may be awarded to an individual offeror. TYPE OF INSTRUMENTS THAT MAY BE AWARDED: FAR based procurement contracts or other transactions (OT) under 10 USC 4021, 10 USC 4022 and 10 USC 4023 (previously 10 USC 4002, 2371, 10 USC 4003, 2371b and 4004, 2373) In the event that an Other Transaction for Prototype agreement is awarded as a result of this competitive ARA, and the prototype project is successfully completed, there is the potential for a prototype project to transition to award of a follow-on production contract or transaction. The Other Transaction for Prototype agreement itself will also contain a similar notice of a potential follow-on production contract or agreement. title: PRESOLICITATION NOTICE FOR GATE HOIST MACHINERY PAINTING AND HOIST HOUSE REHABILITATION FOR FOX RIVER DAMS, WISCONSIN
description: ** This Pre-Solicitation Notice is being issued by the United States Army Corps of Engineers- Chicago District to inform interested vendors of the district?s intent to issue a solicitation for Gate Hoist Machinery Painting and Hoist House Rehabilitation for Fox River Dams, Wisconsin. ** ** PROJECT INFORMATION: The Government is seeking a contractor to 1) repaint the gate hoisting machinery and 2) to rehabilitate the gate hoist houses for 9 (nine) US Army Corps of Engineers (USACE) operated dams on the Fox River, Wisconsin. The dams include the following: Kaukauna Dam, Little Chute Dam, Cedars Dam, Appleton Lower Dam, Menasha Dam, Appleton Upper Dam, DePere Dam, Little Kaukauna Dam, and Rapid Croche Dam.Base 1 repainting work includes surface preparation and painting of the various gate hoisting machinery located at each dam. Base 2 hoist houses rehabilitation work at each dam includes: (1) replacing the existing shingle roofing with metallic sheet roofing; (2) replacing current doors with heavy duty commercial doors (modify existing door wall framing as needed ISO heavier doors); (3) replacing exterior vinyl siding with galvalume siding; (4) replacing the exterior soffit fascia; and (5) insulating the ceiling and wall cavities.Material specifications and installation procedures will be in accordance with the USACE EM 385-1-1 requirements and procedures summarized in a scope of work. ** ** ACQUISITION INFORMATION: Competition for this acquisition is RESERVED EXCLUSIVELY for Small Business Concerns. The North American Industry System Classification Code is 236220, with a small business size standard in dollars of $45.0 Million. All responsible sources may submit a quotation, bid, or proposal, as appropriate, which will be considered by the agency. The requirement is for one (1) year. The solicitation package, bid opening, and award is planned for advertisement Fourth Quarter Fiscal Year 2026. ** ** Prospective vendors can download the solicitation and related documents only from DoWs Procurement Integrated Enterprise Environment (PIEE) system, once it is released. The PDF files can be viewed, navigated, or printed using Adobe Acrobat Reader. ** ** IMPORTANT POLICY: Contractors are REQUIRED to be registered in the System for Award Management (SAM) AT THE TIME ITS BID/PROPOSAL IS SUBMITTED, in orderto comply with the annual representations and certifications requirements. Registration can be completed free of charge at www.sam.gov. Contractors also must register with sam.gov, prior to registering PIEE. Your firm must register with PIEE in order to access the solicitation and to place a bid/proposal in response to the upcoming USACE Solicitation. Use the PIEE System Registration link: ? https://piee.eb.mil and follow the instructions on their website. Request for Solicitation packages made by telephone, fax, or e-mail will not be honored. ** ** Information regarding the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers process for settling requests for equitable adjustments and duration goals to achieve definitization of equitable adjustments for change orders under construction contracts can be found by going to https://www.usace.army.mil/Strategic-Partnerships/Partnering/mod/129895/details/443/ then scrolling down on right hand side of page by clicking on ?View FFP Contract Changes Playbook Here?. ** ** The Point of Contract for this acquisition is Ericka Hillard at ericka.d.hillard@usace.army.mil. ** ** Please include Solicitation number W912P626BA026 on all correspondence. **

title: General Construction QRT Source List
description: Defence Construction Canada (DCC) is inviting contractors to apply to be placed on QRT source list(s) for work required by the Department of National Defence, at 22 Wing North Bay, Ontario. The source list will be in place until August 6, 2029. Applications will be accepted for the following category of service(s): General Contractors DCC may utilize QRTs for projects with an estimated value between $100,000 and $500,000. Contractors that want to join a QRT source list, must submit their application by e-mail using the Source List application form. Attention: Rowana Brown Email address:  NBContracting@dcc-cdc.gc.ca Application forms sent by fax or mail will not be accepted.  Interested contractors may request to join the SL at any time, subject to the SL terms and conditions. Upon receipt of a request, an administrative processing time of approximately 10 days is required to be included in this SL. However, DCC is requesting that interested contractors submit a request to join the SL as soon as possible, preferably by August 6, 2026. The language selected by the applicant for a QRT Source List will be the only language used for the tender documents, the contract documents and communication for all future tenders and during the execution of any resulting contract. The language selected will apply for the duration of the QRT Source List. This procurement is in accordance with the tendering procedures found in Chapter 5 of the Canadian Free Trade Agreement. Although a security clearance is not required to be added to a source list, contractors are advised that tenders and contracts under the QRT source list(s) may contain organization and personnel security requirements. Typically, the organization security requirement will be Designated Organization Screening (DOS) and reliability status for personnel. However more stringent requirement may apply such as Facility Security Clearance (FSC) at the level of SECRET with approved Document Safeguarding (DSC) with secret clearance for personnel. See the enclosed QRT Source List Terms and Conditions for additional information. Contracts put in place by DCC include measurable performance standards and requirements as detailed in form DCL81-Performance Evaluation Guidelines which is available at https://www.dcc-cdc.gc.ca/industry/forms. title: Justification for an Exception to Fair Opportunity Innovation Associates, Inc.
description: This JEFO is valid from the date of approval, July 21, 2025, through the conclusion of the period of performance, July 22, 2029. This is a Class JEFO for the purchase of annual pharmacy automation equipment maintenance service and support program under Innovation Associates, Inc.�s DLA Troop Support Patient Monitoring and Capital Equipment (PMCE) Contract SPE2D1-19-D-0017. Annual maintenance coverage consists of equipment repair and software updates. Contract SPE2D1-19-D-0017 was awarded under the PMCE Program solicitation SPE2D1-17-R-0001. This Class JEFO will apply to all Service Maintenance Agreement (SMA) orders placed under the subject contract commencing with the date of approval of the Class JEFO through July 22, 2029, when the five-year base and five-year option periods expire. Innovation Associates is the only vendor who can perform maintenance on its Innovation Pharmacy Workflow and Automation System, iA NEXiA, software and ensure the installed systems� performance and cybersecurity accreditation is maintained. Innovation is the Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) and only source for the maintenance services required on the iA NEXiA units because they are the OEM with the sole proprietary license for the operating software. The iA NEXiA, formally known as PharmAssist, is an automated medication dispensing system for oral and solid medications with linked and computerized quality assurance software. The iA NEXiA system is integrated with the Composite Health Care System (CHCS) using digital imagery and bar code technology incorporated into the entirely paperless prescription filling process. The linked quality assurance software with digital images of prescriptions provides a significant safety measure by verifying accuracy for all prescriptions filled at various CHCS-hosted pharmacy sites against the original scanned hard copy prescription. The annual maintenance coverage provided by Innovation consists of equipment repair and software updates. Repairs include annual preventative maintenance (PM) and minor equipment adjustments due to wear and tear. Software updates can include but are not limited to updated drug lists and cyber security changes. The required software updates are proprietary to Innovation. Repairs of the iA NEXiA equipment often require interaction with the iA NEXiA proprietary operating software. Innovation Associates, is the sole manufacturer of the iA NEXiA and are capable of maintaining all system information security certifications, testing and on-going Information Assurance (IA), including security updates and patches. Accordingly, only Innovation Associates can maintain the Authority to Operate and the critical security status of the iA NEXiA systems on an ongoing basis under yearly maintenance programs. Security updates and patches must be thoroughly tested by the manufacturer prior to being applied to their system; therefore, only Innovation Associates can provide maintenance for their manufactured equipment.

title: Germany – IT services: consulting, software development, Internet and support – Dynamisches Beschaffungssystem zur Beschaffung von verschiedenen IT-Dienstleistungen
description: Ziel des uni-assist e.V. ist, ein neues Service-IT-System zur Unterstützung der Zulassungsvorbereitung an deutschen Hochschulen zu entwickeln. Ausgehend von einer am Ende ihres Lebenszyklus angelangten proprietären Software (aBIS) und angesichts der sich beschleunigenden Digitalisierung der Zulassungsvorbereitung, dem weiter wachsenden Interesse internationaler degree seeker an einem Studium in Deutschland sowie dem zurzeit häufig beschriebenen Bedarf an (internationalen) Fachkräften in Deutschland 1 ist es für den Verein unabdingbar, zügig ein neues System zu etablieren, um (i) internationalen Studieninteressierten eine intuitiv und einfach nutzbare Plattform zur Einreichung ihrer Studienbewerbungen zur Verfügung zu stellen, (ii) den im Verein organisierten deutschen Hochschulen ein transparentes und faires Auswahlverfahren zu ermöglichen, (iii) die internen Bewertungsprozesse effizient und qualitativ hochwertig abzubilden und (iv) auf Basis der generierten Daten, Handlungsempfehlungen und Verfahrensoptimierungen für interne und externe Stakeholder*innen zu entwickeln. Zentrale Ziele der Neuentwicklung sind (i) die technologische sukzessive Ablösung des Alt-Systems, (ii) die Erhöhung des Automatisierungsgrads in den Verfahrensprozessen und (iii) die möglichst vollständige Digitalisierung der Prozesse bei (iv) gleichzeitiger Steigerung der Usability für die Nutzer*innen sowie (v) der Wahrung und Sicherstellung aller (datenschutz-) rechtlichen Normen. Dafür benötigt der AG die nachfolgenden IT-Dienstleistungen (Kategorie): 1. Unterstützung in der Softwareentwicklung (bspw. Programmieren, Steuern der Scrum-Teams, Testen) 2. Unterstützung des Anforderungsmanagements 3. Unterstützung in der Systemadministration 4. Unterstützung in Wahrung und Weiterentwicklung der IT- und Datenschutzsicherheit 5. Unterstützung in der Koordination des Softwareentwicklungsprojekts und Beratung der IT-Abteilung (bspw. PMO, Projektleitung, Agile Coaching, Datenmanagement)

title: Vehicle Wrap Advertising - Delaware
description: Notice Type: Sources Sought Notice ID: W50S6X26Q0008 Title: Vehicle Wrap Advertising - Delaware NAICS Code: 541810 (Advertising Agencies) OR 541850 (Outdoor Advertising) 1. DISCLAIMER This is a Sources Sought Notice only. This notice is issued solely for market research and planning purposes in accordance with FAR Part 10. It does NOT constitute a Request for Quote (RFQ), Request for Proposal (RFP), or a promise to issue a solicitation in the future. This notice does not commit the U.S. Government to contract for any supply or service whatsoever. The Government will not pay for any information or administrative costs incurred in response to this notice; all costs associated with responding to this notice will be solely at the interested party�s expense. Not responding to this notice does not preclude participation in any future competitive solicitation, if one is issued. 2. BACKGROUND & REQUIREMENT SUMMARY The 166th Mission Support Contracting is conducting market research to identify potential small business and socioeconomic contractors capable of providing a targeted vehicle-wrap advertising and brand ambassador campaign. The contractor shall provide fully wrapped vehicles that will operate in highly visible, targeted zones across Delaware (Middletown, Dover, Georgetown/Milton, and Delaware Beach Towns). The core deliverables include: Fleet Branding: Ten (10) fully wrapped vehicles � complete coverage (doors, hood, trunk, and back windows), to include installation and de-installation. Targeting & Vetting: Sourcing drivers whose daily routes align with the specified target zones. Drivers must pass comprehensive background checks. Collateral Distribution: Distribution of up to 2,000 Government-provided brochures (approx. 200 per vehicle) by the drivers. Analytics & Reporting: Monthly reporting to include Proof of Performance photos, GPS tracking heat maps, mileage tracking, and verified impression counts to calculate overall campaign exposure. 3. REQUESTED INFORMATION / CAPABILITY STATEMENT Interested parties are requested to submit a Capability Statement (no more than 5 pages) addressing their ability to perform the services described above. Please include the following administrative information and answer the generic and specific capability questions below. A. Administrative & Company Information: Company Name, Address, and Point of Contact (Name, Title, Phone, Email). Unique Entity ID (UEI) and CAGE Code. Business Size and Socioeconomic Status under NAICS 541810 (e.g., Small Business, 8(a), HUBZone, SDVOSB, WOSB). Are these services available on an existing Government-wide Acquisition Contract (GWAC) or GSA Multiple Award Schedule (MAS)? If yes, please provide the contract number. Are your services considered commercial under the definition provided in FAR 2.101? B. Capability Questions: Do you have an established network of local drivers operating within Middletown, Dover, Georgetown/Milton, and the Delaware Beach Towns? How do you map and vet driver routes to ensure the wrapped vehicles are frequently operating in our specific target geographic areas? Are your drivers willing and contractually able to distribute physical promotional collateral (brochures) to passengers/the public, and how do you track their distribution compliance? What specific background checks (e.g., criminal, driving record) do you mandate for your drivers before campaign launch? Do you have the capability to provide monthly GPS heat maps and real-time mileage tracking of the wrapped vehicles? How do you calculate your impression metrics, and do you use an independent or third-party verification system for this data? 4. Pre-Solicitation Questions & Answers (Q&A) The following Anticipated Q&A is provided to assist interested parties in understanding the Government's requirement and the current market research phase. Q1: Is there an incumbent contractor currently performing these exact services? A1: No, this is a new requirement for the Government. Q2: Has a decision been made regarding a small business set-aside for this requirement? A2: No. The purpose of this Sources Sought is to conduct market research to determine the availability of capable small businesses (including 8(a), HUBZone, SDVOSB, and WOSB). The Government will use the responses to this notice to make an informed decision on the acquisition strategy and any potential set-asides. Q3: Will the Government provide the 2,000 brochures/literature pieces, or is the contractor responsible for the printing costs? A3: The Government will provide the physical brochures/literature pieces to the contractor. The contractor is only responsible for the allocation and distribution of these materials via the campaign drivers. Q4: Does the Government require the vehicles to be dedicated solely to this campaign, or can they be active rideshare vehicles operating their normal routes? A4: The Government expects these to be active rideshare (or similar) vehicles operating their normal daily routes, provided those routes consistently overlap with the targeted geographic zones (Middletown, Dover, Georgetown/Milton, and Delaware Beach Towns). Q5: Will the Government accept alternative advertising methods, such as public transit (buses/trains) or static billboards? A5: At this time, the Government is specifically researching the capability for wrapped rideshare/ambassador vehicles that allow for targeted geographic roaming and direct passenger collateral distribution. However, if a vendor believes an alternative approach meets the core intent and deliverables, they are welcome to detail that alternative in their Capability Statement. Q6: When does the Government anticipate releasing the official Request for Quote (RFQ) or Request for Proposal (RFP)? A6: The solicitation release date is currently To Be Determined (TBD) and is contingent upon the results of this market research and subsequent funding availability. 5. SUBMISSION INSTRUCTIONS Responses must be submitted via email to the Contract Specialist, Michael Palet Michael.palet.1@us.af.mil and the Contracting Officer Bryan.Driscoll.5@us.af.mil no later than 26 July 2026 at 2359 EST. Please include "Sources Sought Response: Vehicle Wrap Advertising - [Company Name]" in the email subject line. Telephone inquiries will not be accepted. Note: The Government will compile all submitted questions and post the answers publicly as an amendment to the Sources Sought notice on SAM.gov. Please do not include proprietary or confidential information in your questions
